overview: City Council candidate Nate Merritt discussed his policy positions regarding citywide rezoning initiatives and the future of the Medford High School facility.

items.title: Citywide Rezoning and Housing Goals
items.summary: Merritt critiqued the city's rezoning strategy, citing concerns about rising property taxes for single-family homeowners and a lack of specific affordable housing goals.

items.title: High School Construction and Renovation
items.summary: Merritt expressed a preference for evaluating renovation options for the high school to ensure value for taxpayers and minimize the burden on residents with fixed incomes.
